Bug_Title: Dm: Creation of ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor with zero core threads (DMI_SCHEDULED_THREAD_POOL_EXECUTOR_WITH_ZERO_CORE_THREADS)
Bug_Details:
(Javadoc)
A ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor with zero core threads will never execute anything; changes to the max pool size are ignored.
Bug_Explanation: A ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor is created with zero core threads, which means it will never execute any scheduled tasks. A task is scheduled to be executed after 1 second, but since there are no threads available to execute it, the task is never run.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case creates a ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor with zero core threads, which is a bug that causes the task to never be executed. The test case then asserts that the task has not been executed, which should cause the test to fail.
